{{Quote|Davik says you missed your last payment.|The bounty hunter, to the merchant|<ref name="KotOR" />}}
This '''Human bounty hunter''' worked for the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Davik Kang]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] in [[3956 BBY]]. Paired with a [[Unidentified Aqualish bounty hunter (Upper City)|fellow Aqualish]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], he tried to extort 100 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] from a [[Unidentified Taris merchant|merchant]], who owed them to Kang. The [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] did not have the money, and the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunters prepared to take him to Kang, who would [[Death/Legends|kill]] him as an example to others who did not pay their debts. However, the two bounty hunters were killed by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], who rescued the merchant.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Hold on a second. Looks like we got ourselves a witness here!|The bounty hunter, noticing Revan|<ref name="KotOR" />}}
This [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], worked for the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Davik Kang]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]]<ref name="KotOR" /> in [[3956 BBY]].<ref name="CG" /> When an elderly [[Unidentified Taris merchant|merchant]] failed to repay his hundred-[[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] debt he owed to Kang, the crime lord sent this Human [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunter and an [[Unidentified Aqualish bounty hunter (Upper City)|Aqualish]] hunter to extort money from the [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]]. Cornering the man in the [[Upper City]], the two bounty hunters tried to force him to pay the credits. The merchant, however, did not have the full sum at his disposal and instead offered fifty credits as a down payment. The bounty hunters did not agree to his terms and prepared to take him to Kang, as an example for other debtors. Realizing that Kang would [[Death/Legends|kill]] him, the merchant cried for help.<ref name="KotOR" />
{{GameLSmechanics|Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic}}
The exchange was witnessed by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], who was on the planet in [[Rescue of Bastila Shan|search]] for the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Bastila Shan]]. Hearing the merchant's scream, Revan decided to intervene and help the man, telling the bounty hunters to let him go. As Kang did not want to leave any witnesses behind, the Human and the Aqualish attacked Revan, but they were killed by him.<ref name="KotOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Sorry, you're out of time. Now it's all or nothing. Davik can't have people not paying his debts!|The bounty hunter, rejecting the merchant's offer of a down payment|<ref name="KotOR" />}}
[[File:LetsShootTheOldGuyAndTakeHisMoney.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The bounty hunters corner the merchant.]]
This bounty hunter did not feel any compassion for the merchant's predicament and, despite the man's desperate pleas, wanted to take the man to Kang. He was loyal to Kang and took orders only from him. At the [[Time/Legends|time]] of his death, the Human carried a blaster pistol and fifty credits with him. The man had [[Color/Legends|brown]] hair and [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and dark skin.<ref name="KotOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Come on. We don't want to keep Davik waiting&mdash;that's only going to make things worse.|The bounty hunter, to the merchant, in a non-canon outcome in which Revan backs off|<ref name="KotOR" />}}
This bounty hunter appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'' as a non-player character whom the player encounters early in the game. This article follows the [[canon]]ical [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] walkthrough, although the player, controlling Revan, has several options in dealing with the bounty hunters in the game. The player may attack the bounty hunters in anger or decide not to intervene in the situation at all, in which case the Human and the Aqualish will take the merchant to Kang. If the player approaches the bounty hunters while wearing [[Sith trooper armor/Legends|Sith trooper armor]], they will remind him that Kang has an agreement with the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith]], according to which they do not interfere in his business and vice versa. If, following this, Revan pretends to be a Sith and orders the bounty hunters to release the merchant, they will reply that they take orders from Kang only and attack the player.<ref name="KotOR" />
